General Information
NEW in the Original Packaging
Stocked & Shipped From – LEXINGTON, KY
What is This Part?
This part is the OEM Upper Windshield Frame Rubber Seal.
This part attaches to the top part of the windshield frame.
It comes with adhesive backing pre-applied so there are no tools needed to install.
Direct Replacement
What Will I Receive?
Qty 1 – Upper Windshield Weatherstrip (Rubber)
What Vehicle Will This Fit?
Suzuki Samurai 1985 – 1995 All Models
Suzuki SJ410 1980 – 1984 All Models
